book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: JA' AN CARTA TET EB CREYENTE HEBREO

content: Ja' Jesús Yaawil Yak'omal Cu Xaambal Tet Dios Yin Jun Ac' Trato
Ja' jun ti' chi wal e ex an, yu sna'cha el je yu. Ey jun yaawil yak'omal cu xaambal chotan ey naj tinani' bey swatx' k'ab Dios bey sdespacho bey satcan.
Lalan smulna naj yin yak'omal oj xaambal bey jun sna Dios ja' caw. Ja' naj Kaawil jix wa'nen jun na tu', man ánima oj jix wa'neni.
Jun jun c'al yaawil yak'omal xaambal ey yopiso chi yak' sa'beal, chi yak'on pax xaambal, yuxan quey pax tu' naj Jesucristo, sowalil ey tzet yetal chi yak' naj.
Ta chi ec' naj yul yiban k'inal ti', c'am yopiso naj yin yak'omal oj xaambal, yutol ey to c'al ec' eb ey yopiso yak'omal xaambal yu sley Moisés.

Ja' tzet yetal chi yun eb bey yul yiban k'inal ti', tx'oxbanile ye yu tzet yetal ey bey satcan. Kotaj tol tx'oxbanile ye wan ti', yutol ja' yet c'am to chi wa'xi jun Snail Sley Dios tu' yu naj Moisés tu', catu' jix al-le tet naj yu cu Mam Dios jaxca ti': —Moisés, ab tzet chi wal an. Wa'ne masanil jaxca jun yechel jix jin tx'ox ja wil bey sjolom jun wonan an, ẍi Dios tet naj Moisés.

Jal pax naj Kaawil chi ak'on cu xaambal tinani' xin, yel xa c'al watx' smulnail tet tzet chi yun eb naj tu', yutol ja' jun ac' strato Dios jix wa'xi yetoj ánima, yel xa c'al watx' tet jun babel strato Dios yetoj ánima, yutol ja' tzet yetal jix yak' can sti' Dios yin jun ac' trato yel xa c'al watx' tet yet jun babel trato.
Ta tz'ajan jun babel trato tu', c'am xa sowalil jun ac' trato.
Jix il-le spenail yin eb ánima yu cu Mam Dios. Jaxca chi yal yul An Juun:

content.text: —Ey jun ánima oj jul oj. Oj jin wa'ne junoj ac' trato yetoj eb a Israel c'al yetoj eb a Judá.

Ja' jun trato ti', man jaxca jun jix jin wa'ne yetoj yichmam eb an yet jix wi'on eltej eb yetoj jin k'ab bey tx'otx' Egipto an. Pero ma sjije eb jun trato jix jin wa'ne yetoj eb tu' an. Yuxan jix jin bej can eb an.
Ja' yet oj law oj jun tiempoal tu', oj jin wa'ne jun ac' trato yetoj eb a conob Israel an.
Oj yal jaxca ti': Oj waoc jin chejbanil yin sna'bal eb an, catu' oj jin oc Sdiosal oj eb an, catu' oj oc eb jin conob oj an.
Man sowalil oj chi yal-le eb tet yet c'al tet yuẍtaj yu jin yotajne el eb an. Yutol masanil eb icham ánima c'al eb unin oj jin yotajne el eb an.
Oj wak' miman c'ulal yin spenail eb an, catu' man xa oj jin na'ontenetej spenailal eb tu' an, ẍi naj Kaawil yul An Juun.

content: Ja' yet jix yalon cu Mam Dios yu jun ac' trato ti', chi cu na' el oj tol lalan xilbi el jun babel trato tu'. Ta ey junoj tzet yetal lalan xilbi el oj, c'am xa tzet chi oqui, tuxa oj q'uey el oj.
